subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should enabled elevated access default allowed sessions into host exec routing, or should sandbox exec remain the default until the user or tool explicitly requests elevation?
rationale: The current behavior crosses the sandbox boundary, but changing the fallback or /elevated ask semantics changes a documented security/control contract for existing operators.

options.title: Sandbox-first elevated
options.body: Default implicit elevated level to off and make host exec require explicit per-call or session elevation, with docs and tests updated together.

options.title: Keep active-session semantics
options.body: Keep the current default-on and ask-as-on contract, then close this as intended behavior after documenting the security tradeoff clearly.

options.title: Compatibility transition
options.body: Keep current behavior for existing configs but add an explicit migration, doctor warning, or opt-in policy path before changing the default.

recommendation.title: Sandbox-first elevated
recommendation.body: Default implicit elevated level to off and make host exec require explicit per-call or session elevation, with docs and tests updated together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits and docs work touch the elevated, exec, and auto-reply decision surfaces most directly.
